control_rule: one frozen base-10 integer gold schema is applied to exactly 28 finished-correct rows for every runnable pipeline; any failed or unavailable selected control disqualifies the pipeline
fallback_origin_rule: report only when call tracing proves origin

accidental_correct_pct.denominator: applicable rows within the separately reported stratum
accidental_correct_pct.numerator: rows scored correct by the harness-native downstream path

answer_is_numeric_pct.denominator: rows with a returned answer within the separately reported stratum
answer_is_numeric_pct.numerator: returned-answer strings containing at least one Unicode digit

answer_returned_after_truncation_pct.denominator: applicable rows within the separately reported real or constructed-synthetic stratum
answer_returned_after_truncation_pct.numerator: rows with a non-null, non-empty extracted answer

control_pass_pct.denominator: the same 28 frozen integer-gold controls for every runnable pipeline
control_pass_pct.numerator: selected controls scored correct by the actual pipeline

crash_pct.denominator: applicable rows within the separately reported stratum
crash_pct.numerator: rows with an exception escaping the adapter invocation

swallowed_error_pct.denominator: applicable rows within the separately reported stratum
swallowed_error_pct.numerator: rows with a defined observable suppressed-error event

pre_truncation_answer_present.definition: text contains the frozen nonempty syntactic marker regex \\boxed\{.+?\}

reporting_separation: real and constructed synthetic results never share a metric row, table cell, denominator, or headline
